findings.issue: Carried from round 1 (optional, unchanged): observedBySeat destructures each entry without checking it is an object, so a null/undefined entry throws TypeError rather than the documented RangeError; seat is not type-checked (a non-SeatNumber seat is silently ignored by the Map lookup).

findings.fix: Optional: when session code that builds the snapshot lands, or if it ever crosses the worker boundary, add an object/null check and an integer 1..6 seat check, and validate it in AdviceRequest like id/seed.

summary: No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings. Round 1 had no blocking findings. Round-1 fix diff (71f284b..056065c) reviewed: basisText and OBSERVED_MIN_HANDS moved into explanations.ts to break the ranges<->explain import cycle. basisText now uses String.prototype.replace with String(observedHands) as the replacement. Its only input is a validated non-negative integer, so '$' replacement patterns cannot occur, and the output is plain text with no HTML sink. hand-order.json only changed its justification string; it is still a committed, bundled file validated at import by parseHandOrder, and the order and equities are unchanged. Snapshot validation, the bot boundary (adviceOptions whitelist; observedOpponents never reaches bots), hidden-information isolation and fail-closed behaviour are unchanged from round 1. No new dependencies, secrets, network, logging, file I/O or randomness.
